name: the-automation-engine
description: Manage The Automation Engine automations that switch Meta, TikTok and Amazon ads on and off, or adjust Amazon bids, in response to real-world data such as weather, sports results, stock levels and time of day.

interface.longDescription:
The Automation Engine changes your online ads in response to real-world data, so an ad can pause when it rains or when a product sells out without anyone doing it by hand.

Connect your The Automation Engine account to review and manage your team's automations from ChatGPT:
- See which automations are on, whether they run live or as a dry run, and when they last checked their rules.
- Read and change the rules (cues) each automation follows: weather, air quality and pollen, sports fixtures and results, Formula 1, airport delays, public holidays, paydays, time of day, Shopify and Amazon stock levels.
- Choose which ads each set of rules switches on, or for Amazon bid automations, which ad groups have their bids raised or lowered.
- Turn automations on or off and switch between live and dry run.

Who it's for: brands and agencies running ads on Meta, TikTok or Amazon who already use The Automation Engine.

Limitations: you need an account with The Automation Engine. New automations are created in the web app, where you sign in to your ad network and choose the campaign to control; ChatGPT gives you the link and then helps set it up. Automations are checked every ten minutes, so changes to ads take effect at the next check, not immediately. Every action is limited to the team you connect and is recorded in the automation's history.
capabilities: Add, change and remove automation rules
Choose which ads or ad groups each rule controls
Switch between live and dry run
defaultPrompt: Which of my ad automations are switched on right now?
Explain the rules in my newest automation.
Only run my summer ads when it's above 20°C in London.

positive.description: List the team's automations with their on/off status and mode.
positive.prompt: Which of my ad automations are switched on right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo team's automations by name and brand, saying which are on and whether each runs live or as a dry run. Only automations from the connected team are shown.

positive.description: Explain one automation's rules in plain language.
positive.prompt: Explain the rules in my Summer Sale automation.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Summer Sale automation and describes each combination of cues (for example 'the temperature in London is more than 20°C') and whether all or any of them must be true, without inventing rules that are not there.

positive.description: Add a weather rule to an existing automation.
positive.prompt: In my Summer Sale automation, add a rule so its ads only run when it's warmer than 20°C in London.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up London as a weather location and adds a current-temperature cue set to more than 20°C to Summer Sale, then confirms the new rule and that it applies from the next ten-minute check.

positive.prompt: Turn off my Summer Sale automation.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms with the user, then turns Summer Sale off and reports that it will stop changing its ads and can be turned back on later. Nothing is deleted.

positive.description: Get the link and steps for creating a new automation.
positive.prompt: I want to set up a new automation for my TikTok ads.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a link to create the automation in The Automation Engine web app and the TikTok-specific steps (sign in to TikTok, choose the campaign and ad group), and explains that the rules and ads can be set up in ChatGPT afterwards.

negative.description: Deleting automations is not supported; only turning them off is.
Ad budgets and creative are managed in the ad network, not by this plugin.
negative.prompt: Raise my Meta campaign's daily budget to $500.

negative.description: Only the connected team's automations are accessible.
negative.prompt: Show me the automations belonging to another company's team.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: view and manage ad automations, their rules, controlled ads and ad groups, on/off status and live or dry-run mode.
